description: Piano 1024 is a playable synth piano inside ChatGPT. Learn songs phrase by phrase with fingering and hands-separate practice; build chord progressions and melodies you refine across the conversation; hear and name any chord; keep a metronome in any meter; and train your ear with graded interval, chord, and scale drills. Every note is synthesized live on the in-chat keyboard — tap to play, no samples or setup. Part of the 1024 family of music tools.

defaultPrompt: Give me a metronome at 96 BPM, pitched to D.
Play a I–V–vi–IV progression in C, and loop it.
Teach me to play Twinkle Twinkle.
